command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=$(mktemp -d /tmp/fred-omega-grf-rebased.XXXXXX)
echo SCRATCH_ROOT=$ROOT
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT/discriminator" -- --depth 1 --single-branch --branch chatgpt/fred-grf-discriminator-converge-20260913
cd "$ROOT/discriminator"
HEAD1=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo DISCRIMINATOR_HEAD=$HEAD1; test "$HEAD1" = cabcaa84101706c8d539a164d21e2fae93fd7803
python3 AI_START_HERE_DO_NOT_SCAN_REPO/validate_routes.py
python3 scripts/omega_runtime.py selftest
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_grf_brain.py scripts/omega_grf_causal_discriminator.py scripts/omega_grf_discriminator.py scripts/f2wp1207_grid10_turn_loop.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grf_discriminator.py tests/test_omega_grf_brain.py tests/test_omega_grf_grid_contract.py tests/test_omega_grf_turn_forensics.py tests/test_omega_grf_causal_discriminator.py
echo OMEGA_GRF_DISCRIMINATOR_REBASED_PASS=1
cd /tmp
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/frankenstein "$ROOT/trusted-ingest" -- --depth 1 --single-branch --branch chatgpt/fred-cross-host-trusted-ingest-converge-20260913
cd "$ROOT/trusted-ingest"
HEAD2=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo TRUSTED_INGEST_HEAD=$HEAD2; test "$HEAD2" = a1e134baf5643e49093e2f437c5ffb7f33c0e311
python3 AI_START_HERE_DO_NOT_SCAN_REPO/validate_routes.py
python3 scripts/omega_runtime.py selftest
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_grid_source_trusted_import.py scripts/omega_grid_source_envelope.py scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py
python3 scripts/omega_grid_source_trusted_import.py selftest
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grid_source_trusted_import.py tests/test_omega_grid_unified_ingest.py tests/test_omega_grf_causal_discriminator.py
echo OMEGA_CROSS_HOST_TRUSTED_INGEST_REBASED_PASS=1
